trailhead.label: Diavolezza top station, the board’s start

cautions: High alpine at 3,000 m: the air is thin, the weather turns fast and snow can fall in any month.
Rocky path; OSM grades about 200 m near the summit as demanding mountain path (T3): keep your dog close and on a short lead.
Glaciers below the ridge: never leave the marked path.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
